title: AKARI Video intake.json v0
description: Storage for the intake form. The single source of truth for the user's tasks, target duration, and autonomy. The AI partner follows these choices, including without a UI (for example, in Claude Code). Evolve by adding optional fields only; do not change the meaning or type of existing fields or remove them. Introduce breaking changes in a separate schema with a v1 $id, leaving this v0 unchanged.

version.description: The intake.json schema version. Currently fixed at 1.

title.description: The project's display name, independent of its folder name. Keep the creation-time-based machine ID as the folder name and store the readable name here (owner decision, 2026-08-09). Defaults to null (unset); displays resolve title ?? folder name. The creation dialog does not yet accept a title; the agent may write it when intake planning is settled. This optional field does not require a version increment.

tasks.description: Tasks to perform. Only stable IDs from the skill catalog are allowed; unknown IDs fail validation. Use x-akari-labels for display labels.

autonomy.description: Autonomy: As is (follow instructions and export without review), With suggestions (default; add suitable suggestions, show them, and ask for review once before export), or Make it together (review key decisions about direction, footage, and execution).

status.description: draft means the approach is not yet confirmed. The partner follows tasks / target / autonomy only after status becomes submitted.

submitted_at.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp is required when status is submitted. Must be null for draft.

x-akari-labels.$comment: Single source for stable IDs and display labels. Both forms and partner summaries use these labels (owner decision, 2026-07-21, section 8-3: stable IDs are canonical; labels are for display).

x-akari-autonomy-labels.$comment: Canonical display labels for stable IDs. IDs and defaults remain unchanged.

taskId.description: An extensible enum of stable IDs. Add new entries when new skills become available.

duration_s.description: Target duration in seconds. Mutually exclusive with keep_length: true.

keep_length.description: Keep the footage's original duration when true. Mutually exclusive with a non-null duration_s.

taste.description: Optional free-form description of style and mood.
